name: Security / Authentication
description: On-demand PC/SC/YubiKey inventory and confirmed YubiKey personalization.
help_text: Inventory starts pcscd only inside the reader workflow and stops it afterward, or selects a YubiKey index for ykinfo. Personalization exposes dry-run/commit profiles, keeps key material in one-time redacted private inputs, and requires exact token/slot confirmation before writes or deletion.
